meta.name: performance-diagnosis
meta.description: Diagnose why campaigns are underperforming. Trigger on "low performance", "high CPL", "bad ads".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断广告系列表现不佳的原因
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为广告高成本低转化发愁
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose why your ad campaigns are underperforming
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're struggling with high cost and low conversion in ads

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析广告系列表现不佳的原因，找出根本问题并给出修复建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“低绩效”、“高 CPL”或“广告效果差”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我的广告系列 CPL 太高了，帮我诊断一下。
say.note: Claude 会分析可能的原因并给出优化建议。

say.text: 最近广告效果很差，问题出在哪里？
say.note: Claude 会检查 offer、受众、创意等环节。

say.text: 帮我看看这个广告系列为什么转化率低。
say.note: Claude 会找出瓶颈并提供修复方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will diagnose why campaigns are underperforming, identify the root cause, and suggest fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "low performance", "high CPL", or "bad ads".

say_en.text: My campaign CPL is too high, please diagnose.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze possible causes and suggest optimizations.

say_en.text: My ads are performing poorly lately, what's the issue?
say_en.note: Claude will check offer, audience, creative, etc.

say_en.text: Help me figure out why this campaign has low conversion.
say_en.note: Claude will find the bottleneck and provide fixes.
